# Career Command Resume + Job Fit Audit

Problem: A job seeker has a real opening and needs an evidence-backed comparison between their supplied background and the target role without fabricated credentials or fake proprietary ATS certainty.
Pricing: Free core is available. No premium machine-lane price is approved yet.
Commercial state: verify
Machine state: discovery_only
Public capability: https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?view=service&public_id=career-command-resume-job-fit-machine-v1
Machine offer JSON: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- check my resume against this job
- why am I not getting interviews
- tailor my resume to this opening
- is my resume ATS friendly
- what am I missing for this job
- resume job match
- audit my resume

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
